get_model_cost_map: get the model cost map dict by fetching from remote URL or loading local backup
load_local_model_cost_map: load the local backup model cost map bundled with the litellm package
fetch_remote_model_cost_map: fetch the model cost map JSON from a remote URL with configurable timeout
validate_model_cost_map: validate the integrity of a fetched model cost map against backup model count
get_model_cost_map_source_info: get metadata about the source of the currently loaded model cost map
